entries.title: Job 10:1
segments: ¶"My soul loathes my life; I will give free course to my complaint, I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

entries.title: Job 10:2
segments: I will say to God, 'Do not condemn me; Show me why You contend with me.

entries.title: Job 10:3
segments: [Does it] seem good to You that You should oppress, That You should despise the work of Your hands, And smile on the counsel of the wicked?

entries.title: Job 10:4
segments: Do You have eyes of flesh? Or do You see as man sees?

entries.title: Job 10:5
segments: [Are] Your days like the days of a mortal man? [Are] Your years like the days of a mighty man,

entries.title: Job 10:6
segments: That You should seek for my iniquity And search out my sin,

entries.title: Job 10:7
segments: Although You know that I am not wicked, And [there is] no one who can deliver from Your hand?

entries.title: Job 10:8
segments: ¶'Your hands have made me and fashioned me, An intricate unity; Yet You would destroy me.

entries.title: Job 10:9
segments: Remember, I pray, that You have made me like clay. And will You turn me into dust again?

entries.title: Job 10:10
segments: Did you not pour me out like milk, And curdle me like cheese,

entries.title: Job 10:11
segments: Clothe me with skin and flesh, And knit me together with bones and sinews?

entries.title: Job 10:12
segments: You have granted me life and favor, And Your care has preserved my spirit.

entries.title: Job 10:13
segments: 'And these [things] You have hidden in Your heart; I know that this [was] with You:

entries.title: Job 10:14
segments: ¶If I sin, then You mark me, And will not acquit me of my iniquity.

entries.title: Job 10:15
segments: If I am wicked, woe to me; Even [if] I am righteous, I cannot lift up my head. [I am] full of disgrace; See my misery!

entries.title: Job 10:16
segments: If [my head] is exalted, You hunt me like a fierce lion, And again You show Yourself awesome against me.

entries.title: Job 10:17
segments: You renew Your witnesses against me, And increase Your indignation toward me; Changes and war are [ever] with me.

entries.title: Job 10:18
segments: 'Why then have You brought me out of the womb? Oh, that I had perished and no eye had seen me!

entries.title: Job 10:19
segments: I would have been as though I had not been. I would have been carried from the womb to the grave.

entries.title: Job 10:20
segments: Are not my days few? Cease! Leave me alone, that I may take a little comfort,

entries.title: Job 10:21
segments: Before I go [to the place from which] I shall not return, To the land of darkness and the shadow of death,

entries.title: Job 10:22
segments: A land as dark as darkness [itself], As the shadow of death, without any order, [Where] even the light [is] like darkness.'"
